```python
from pydantic import BaseModel

# Step 1: Get all restaurants in Paris
restaurants_str = get_all_restaurants_in_city("Paris")
restaurants = restaurants_str.splitlines()

# Step 2: Filter for Chinese cuisine
cuisine_types = get_cuisine_type_for_restaurants(restaurants)
chinese_restaurants = [name for name in restaurants if cuisine_types.get(name, "").lower() == "chinese"]

# Step 3: Get prices for Chinese restaurants and filter under 34 euros
prices = get_price_for_restaurants(chinese_restaurants)
affordable_restaurants = [name for name in chinese_restaurants if prices.get(name, 1000) < 34]

# Step 4: Get opening hours for affordable restaurants and filter those open on Monday
opening_hours = check_restaurant_opening_hours(affordable_restaurants)

class MondayOpenModel(BaseModel):
    name: str
    is_open_monday: bool

monday_open_results = [
    query_ai_assistant(
        f"Does the following restaurant open on Mondays? Restaurant name: {name}. Opening hours: {opening_hours.get(name, '')}. Return the restaurant name and a boolean indicating if it is open on Monday.",
        MondayOpenModel
    )
    for name in affordable_restaurants
]

open_on_monday = [res.name for res in monday_open_results if res.is_open_monday]

# Step 5: Get ratings and reviews for those open on Monday
ratings_reviews = get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants(open_on_monday)

class RatingModel(BaseModel):
    name: str
    rating: float

ratings = [
    query_ai_assistant(
        f"Extract the numeric rating (out of 5) for the restaurant from the following review and rating information. Restaurant name: {name}. Reviews and ratings: {ratings_reviews.get(name, '')}. Return the restaurant name and the rating as a float.",
        RatingModel
    )
    for name in open_on_monday
]

# Step 6: Find the restaurant with the highest rating
if len(ratings) == 0:
    raise ValueError("No Chinese restaurants in Paris open on Monday under 34 euros per person were found.")

best_restaurant = sorted(ratings, key=lambda x: x.rating, reverse=True)[0].name

# Step 7: Gather all required info for the best restaurant
address = get_restaurants_address([best_restaurant]).get(best_restaurant, "")
price = prices[best_restaurant]
operating_hours = opening_hours[best_restaurant]
rating = [r.rating for r in ratings if r.name == best_restaurant][0]

print(
    "Recommended Restaurant:\n"
    f"Name: {best_restaurant}\n"
    f"Rating: {rating}/5\n"
    f"Address: {address}\n"
    f"Price per person: {price} euros\n"
    f"Operating hours: {operating_hours}"
)
```
